# Policymaker #350: iteration 0058

## What changed and why
- Task #346 merged the manifest binding (owner #348). I checked main: `run_record.py` sha 48404c93…, evaluator exit 0, errors [], missing [], 62 refs. I deleted `execution/scripts/bind_manifest_n1.py`.
- Review #347 accepted the binding, with two non-blocking findings ([snapshot](.github/loop/data/session-reports/347/6310c97e60a3c8e83bb5002383a74f06ad62c78f24564d8f91abd12562a03751.json)). Finding 1: add controls for an uppercase hash and for text input. Finding 2: the "not yet reviewed" text is stale.
- I wrote `execution/scripts/pin_binding_347.py` for both findings. It checks hashes before it changes files, and a second run changes nothing. I ran it two times on a copy of main. All checks (run_record, baseline, score, evaluator) gave exit 0 with 62 refs. When I removed the bytes type test or added case normalization, `--check` gave exit 1.
- Reviewer #347 (Sonnet) and the author (the Policymaker) are both in the Claude model family. The status sentence records this limit.

## Orders (wake false, parallel, from main)
1. `pin-binding-review-347` (benchmark, low, 20 min/25 turns). Expected gain: the binding counts as reviewed. Check: main `run_record.py` sha b39c3060…, 5 `manifest_binding` entries, 62 refs.
2. `populated-manifest-contract-n3` (benchmark, medium, 75 min/45 turns). This is item N3 of gap delta #330: a synthetic populated manifest and `runner_contract.py --check` with at least 4 mutations. It changes no pinned file. Check: `runner_contract.py --check` gives exit 0, and the report lists the undecided fields.

## Limits
The benchmark is not ready and was not executed. Tool quality is not measured. No populated real manifest, runner, native evidence (#169) or reviewed store record exists. Owner request #345 is still open. Product implementation waits for the gate.

## What next
- Verify the pin on main, then delete `pin_binding_347.py`.
- When N3 is complete, order one review from main. Then pin N3 with a script.
- Next, adjudicate N2 lineage in batches: 230 candidate groups in `benchmark/lineage.json`.
- When #345 supplies the record, order one independent review of the record.
- Do not repeat the #347 review probes.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
